gripOrHq.rulesText: [3]: Break up to four wall subroutines on a single piece of ice. [1]: +1 strength. Whenever you use Pile Driver’s break-walls subroutine, lose a total of [3] from stealth cards.

gripOrHq.title: Shield
gripOrHq.rulesText: Prevents up to 2 Net damage each turn.

gripOrHq.title: Baedeker’s Net Map
gripOrHq.rulesText: [0]: Base link 1. [1]: +1 link. Use only one base link card for each trace attempt made against you.

gripOrHq.title: Succubus
gripOrHq.rulesText: Succubus can host up to 3 MU of programs. If Succubus leaves play, trash all hosted programs.

gripOrHq.title: Mantis, Fixer-at-Large
gripOrHq.rulesText: Search your stack for a card, and bring it into your hand. Reshuffle your stack afterwards.

heapOrArchives.title: Lucidrine™ Booster Drug
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Make a run, and gain [9], which you may use only during that run. After that run is completed, suffer 1 brain damage; this damage cannot be prevented. Then, return to the bank any of the [9] not spent.

heapOrArchives.title: The Short Circuit
heapOrArchives.rulesText: A, [1]: Search your stack for a program. Show that program to the Corp, and then bring it into your hand. Reshuffle your stack afterwards.

heapOrArchives.title: Bodyweight™ Synthetic Blood
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Draw five cards.

heapOrArchives.title: Afreet
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Afreet can host up to 3 MU of programs. Hosted programs use Afreet's hosting capacity instead of Runner MU. All icebreakers hosted on Afreet have their strength reduced by 1. If Afreet leaves play, trash all programs hosted on it.

heapOrArchives.title: Short-Term Contract
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Put [12] from the bank on Short-Term Contract when it is installed. When all the bits have been removed, trash Short-Term Contract. A: Take [2] from Short-Term Contract.

heapOrArchives.rulesText: Draw three cards.

heapOrArchives.rulesText: Derez a piece of black ice of your choice.

heapOrArchives.rulesText: Make a run on HQ. If run is successful, do not access cards from HQ; instead, the Corp loses [4].

heapOrArchives.title: If You Want It Done Right...
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Look through the top five cards of your stack. Bring one of those cards into your hand, and arrange the rest in any order you choose.

heapOrArchives.title: Jack ’n’ Joe
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Draw three cards.

heapOrArchives.title: Gideon’s Pawnshop
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Search your trash for a card and bring it into your hand.

heapOrArchives.title: Code Viral Cache
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Play only if you made a successful run on HQ this turn. If the Corp forgoes actions to lose Virus counters, two counters of your choice are not removed. The Corp may trash Code Viral Cache by taking an action to pay [5].

heapOrArchives.title: Armored Fridge
heapOrArchives.rulesText:
Put seven Ablative counters on Armored Fridge when it is installed. When the last Ablative counter has been removed, trash Armored Fridge.
Ablative counter: Prevent 1 meat damage.

heapOrArchives.title: Priority Wreck
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Make a run on HQ. If run is successful, do not access cards from HQ; instead, pay any number of bits to force the Corp to lose that many bits.

rig.title: Codecracker
rig.rulesText:
[0]: Break code gate subroutine.
[1]: +1 strength.

rig.title: Evil Twin
rig.rulesText:
[3]: Break sentry subroutine.
[1]: +1 strength.
Prevents up to 2 net and/or brain damage total each turn.

rig.title: Jackhammer
rig.rulesText:
[0]: Break wall subroutine.
[1]: +1 strength.
Whenever you break a wall subroutine with Jackhammer, lose 1 credit, if you can, from a stealth card.

rig.title: Pattel’s Virus
rig.rulesText: Whenever you make a successful run, put a Pattel counter on a piece of ice that had all its subroutines broken during that run. Each Pattel counter on a piece of ice reduces its strength by 1. The Corp may remove all Virus counters by forgoing its next three actions.

rig.title: Militech MRAM Chip
rig.rulesText: Hand size +3.

rig.title: “Drifter” Mobile Environment
rig.rulesText: Put [2] from the bank on Mobile Environment when it is installed. Use these bits only to pay for removing tags. If you use any of these bits, replace them from the bank at the start of your next turn.

rig.title: Junkyard BBS
rig.rulesText: A, [1]: Bring the top card from your trash into your hand.

rig.title: The Shell Traders
rig.rulesText: A: Choose a program or hardware card from your hand. Set that card aside face up, and put a number of Shell counters on it equal to its installation cost. When the last Shell counter on that card has been removed, install that card, at no cost. Remove one Shell counter from one card at the start of each of your turns. [1]: Remove one Shell counter from a card.

rig.title: Short-Term Contract
rig.rulesText: Put [12] from the bank on Short-Term Contract when it is installed. When all the bits have been removed, trash Short-Term Contract. A: Take [2] from Short-Term Contract.

ice.title: Shock.r
ice.rulesText: [Subroutine] Runner cannot break any subroutines of the next piece of ice encountered during the run, and cannot jack out until after that encounter.

setAside.title: Skivviss
setAside.rulesText: Whenever you make a successful run on R&D, give the Corp a Skivviss counter. Each Skivviss counter requires the Corp to draw one extra card at the start of each of its turns. The Corp may remove all Virus counters by forgoing its next three actions.
